messages:
maria: Heads-up: planning a runtime deploy tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC deploy window. This includes a small change to kernel selection heuristics + a tweaked quantization profile for faster int8 paths.

maria: Need someone to own the deploy and run smoke checks. It should be a canary-first rollout (10% traffic) then 50% then 100% if green.

dave: I can take owner for the canary and first expansion. Will be online at 21:45 UTC to prep.

sunita: I can do the smoke checklist and watch dashboards for 22:00-23:30.

liam: Quick note: this touches the KV cache priming sequence; please include a small cache-warm job after canary.

maria: good call @liam — add cache-warm step after canary. Add logs for prefix-hit-rate.

elaine: Are there new kernel flags? If so, share exact config so infra can validate node images.

maria: Yes, two flags: kernel.selection_policy=seq_len_aware and kernel.max_chunk=2048. Also quant.profile=fast_int8_v3 (non-destructive).

jenna: throwing a quick CRD: PR #4128 updates the runtime bootstrap to respect max_chunk. CI passed. pinging @dave for lgtm.

dave: lgtm on the PR. small comment about a log statement which I fixed inline.

sunita: Smoke checklist (short):
- confirm canary deployed to pool-canary-2
- run sample-gen load with seq length distribution 32/128/512
- check prefix hit rate and KV hit ratio
- verify 95th p99 latency delta < 20%
- sanity compare outputs vs baseline on 50 prompts
- run brief A/B for hallucination regression on 100 prompts

maria: good checklist. Add: ensure fallback routing to v2.13 is enabled and tested.

liam: rollback command for infra if needed: `redwoodctl rollout ops rollback --component engine --to-tag v2.13 --pool pool-canary-2`

ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled deploy window for eng-runtime tonight 22:00-23:00 UTC. Please update the deploy log with start/end times.

elaine: Who's oncall for infra in case we need node kernel rollback? @jenna?

jenna: I'll be standby for infra, reachable on call. If we hit kernel incompat, escalate to infra-sre.

dave: Can someone validate that the model graph quant artifacts are in the artifact store for both canary and fallback? I checked staging but not prod.

sunita: I confirmed artifacts are uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/engine/fast_int8_v3/sha-88a7. Prod manifest includes them.

maria: timeline: 21:45 prep, 22:00 start canary (10%), 22:20 validate + cache-warm, 22:30 expand to 50% if green, 22:50 final 100% if still green.

liam: I'll kick-off cache-warm job and monitor prefix hit.

dave: I'll monitor latency and token throughput, will call rollback at first sign of p95 > 2x baseline or error rate spike.

sunita: I'll run the output-sanity script: `tools/eval/sanity_check.py --prompts samples/healthset_50.json --baseline-tag v2.13` and paste diff summary to the thread.

maria: deployment doc link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-deploy (please add notes).

elaine: small ask: update the console dashboard to show quant.profile tag in the route label so we can filter quickly.

jenna: acknowledged, will add a temporary dashboard filter.

maria: final: anyone object to proceeding?

liam: no objections.

dave: go ahead from me.

sunita: good to go.

maria: thanks team — will start the prep at 21:45 UTC and post status updates here. :white_check_mark:
